Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability to enforce same-batch selection for raw materials in production and batch orders in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. This feature will reach general availability on September 11, 2026.

How does this affect me?
This feature ensures that raw materials consumed by production and batch orders all come from the same batch. Process and discrete manufacturers can use it together with related production-control capabilities that govern how raw materials are allocated to a production order.

Product designers and production engineers can set the same-batch requirement at the released-product level so that it applies by default everywhere the item is consumed. They can optionally fine-tune it for individual bill of materials (BOM) or formula lines where a different rule is appropriate. Production planners and warehouse workers who reserve raw materials for a production or batch order see the system automatically restrict the available on-hand inventory to a single batch per line, instead of mixing quantities from several batches. The result is the consistent, traceable, single-batch consumption pattern that's needed for quality-controlled manufacturing scenarios—without requiring operators to remember and enforce the rule manually.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

If you would like more information on this feature, please visit Enforce same-batch selection for raw materials in production and batch orders.

Title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management - Enforce same-batch selection for raw materials in production and batch orders
